shortDescription: Dashboard home feed view for repository discovery.
fullDescription: Implements the dashboard-home-feed view in its default state with a dark three-column layout, top application header, repository search and ask composer, feed cards for trending and recommended repositories, star controls, and right-side Copilot Day and changelog panels. The view exposes a state prop for supported screen states and keeps visible controls interactive through local state for search, filters, selections, and starring.
